{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gormak''' was the native language of the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] species who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. It shared no similarities with the speech of [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], though the Gormak were also able to understand it.<ref>{{TORcite|Voss}}</ref>
